Frequently Asked Questions
How quickly will I see results? +
Most clients see their first booked calls within 48 to 72 hours of launching. Full momentum builds over the first 2 to 3 weeks as we dial in the targeting.
Do I need to know anything about ads or AI? +
Not at all. We handle everything including ad creative, targeting, and the AI caller setup. You just show up to the calls we book for you.
What makes you different from other agencies? +
Most agencies just run ads and hand you a list of leads. We take it a step further. Our AI caller follows up with every lead instantly, qualifies them, and books them straight into your calendar. You are not getting leads, you are getting booked appointments.
How much does it cost? +
Our service starts at $5,000 per month with ad spend separate. Every business is different so we recommend booking a call so we can walk you through exactly what makes sense for your situation.
